title: Billing and Coding: MolDX: Prognostic and Predictive Molecular Classifiers for Bladder Cancer

codes.1: If a test for FGFR2 and/or FGFR3 is performed as part of a panel, it must be billed as part of the panel. Many of these codes refer to more than 1 possible gene. As such, these codes may be mentioned in unrelated coverage articles as well.
